name: Realizable Ample Classes Are Strictly Realizable COMs
scope: Finite simple COMs and their tope graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every realizable ample class is a realizable COM, and the containment is strict.
proof: Both use affine hyperplanes restricted to an open convex set, with ampleness adding a stronger combinatorial condition. The realizable OM tope graph $C_6$ is not ample.
